Review verdict: 9950X3D is the fastest 16-core chip in gaming, achieves near-parity gaming performance with the 9800X3D, retains strong productivity performance, is fully overclockable and energy efficient with AVX-512 support. Main con noted: pricing.

Benchmarks show the 9950X3D is 37% faster than Intel's Core 9 285K on average in 1080p gaming and 26% faster than the Core i9-14900K, while on average tying the Ryzen 7 9800X3D, long considered the best gaming CPU.

Reviewer's Pros/Cons list for the 9950X3D: Fastest 16-core chip in gaming, near-parity gaming with the 9800X3D, strong productivity performance, fully overclockable, energy efficient, AVX-512 support; only listed con is pricing.

Commenter surprised that even non-gaming tasks benefit significantly from the 3D V-Cache on the 9950X3D, speculating this differs from prior X3D generations possibly because AMD resolved earlier heat issues from the additional cache.
